Name: L_Shoulder,L_Elbow,L_Wrist
Description: This will create a Limb System (v002: matrix nodes instead of constraints, no follicles, parallel evaluation for ~2x faster playback)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a Limb System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- Ribbons: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- TwistAmount: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- IkCtrlType: choose one option (for example: cube, sphere).
- ArmsSoftIk: adds the ArmsSoftIk attr (0-10) to arms, eases the elbow to straight instead of popping at full reach. Arms only, legs use the LegSoftIK block. Off by default.
- Orients: Default keeps the Mutant controller orients, SN uses the studio orients (same as the Custom_Biped_Orients block FixArms/FixLegs, so that block is not needed for limbs).
- ScaleTweakCtrls: not used in v002, the bendy tweakers always scale their own bind joint (non uniform).
- Controllers scale: FK, IK, SubIk, Top IK and Bendy controllers scale the bind joints around them (uniform or non uniform), the controllers under them do not inherit it. FK controllers count in FK, IK controllers in IK. The wrist FK / IK / SubIk controllers do not scale the arm bind joints, they scale the wrist joint (L_Wrist_Jnt) so a hand parented there follows.
- Template parent examples: L_Wrist_Jnt, L_Elbow_Bnd_2_Bnd, R_Elbow_Bnd_2_Bnd.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
